name: convergent-technical-audit
description: Bounded evidence-backed audit of any technical artifact: frozen inputs, sequential lens coverage, conservative independent verification, and two clean generalist rounds, producing a Markdown report and append-only JSONL ledger without rewriting the artifact.

safety.scope: audit report only; never rewrites or implements the source artifact
safety.state: canonical run state is private, durable, outside the audited repository, and never under /tmp
safety.secrets: likely secret-bearing tracked and untracked paths are excluded before content capture unless protected inclusion is explicitly approved
safety.verification: rejection requires affirmative counterevidence from a dedicated deep dive at least as thorough as discovery
safety.delegation: discovery and verification are sequential and may not recursively delegate
safety.termination: reports CONVERGED, CAPPED_NOT_CONVERGED, or BLOCKED without claiming perfection
